comment: Represents a splice insert command defined in SCTE35, Section 9.3.3.

variables.name: spliceEventCancelIndicator
variables.comment: True if the event with id {@link #spliceEventId} has been canceled.

variables.name: outOfNetworkIndicator
variables.comment:
* If true, the splice event is an opportunity to exit from the network feed. If false, indicates
   * an opportunity to return to the network feed.

variables.name: programSpliceFlag
variables.comment:
* Whether the splice mode is program splice mode, whereby all PIDs/components are to be spliced.
   * If false, splicing is done per PID/component.

variables.name: spliceImmediateFlag
variables.comment:
* Whether splicing should be done at the nearest opportunity. If false, splicing should be done
   * at the moment indicated by {@link #programSplicePlaybackPositionUs} or {@link
   * ComponentSplice#componentSplicePlaybackPositionUs}, depending on {@link #programSpliceFlag}.

variables.name: programSplicePts
variables.comment:
* If {@link #programSpliceFlag} is true, the PTS at which the program splice should occur. {@link
   * C#TIME_UNSET} otherwise.

variables.name: programSplicePlaybackPositionUs
variables.comment: Equivalent to {@link #programSplicePts} but in the playback timebase.

variables.name: componentSpliceList
variables.comment:
* If {@link #programSpliceFlag} is false, a non-empty list containing the {@link
   * ComponentSplice}s. Otherwise, an empty list.

variables.name: autoReturn
variables.comment:
* If {@link #breakDurationUs} is not {@link C#TIME_UNSET}, defines whether {@link
   * #breakDurationUs} should be used to know when to return to the network feed. If {@link
   * #breakDurationUs} is {@link C#TIME_UNSET}, the value is undefined.

variables.name: breakDurationUs
variables.comment: * The duration of the splice in microseconds, or {@link C#TIME_UNSET} if no duration is present.

variables.name: uniqueProgramId
variables.comment: The unique program id as defined in SCTE35, Section 9.3.3.

variables.name: availNum
variables.comment: Holds the value of {@code avail_num} as defined in SCTE35, Section 9.3.3.

variables.name: availsExpected
variables.comment: Holds the value of {@code avails_expected} as defined in SCTE35, Section 9.3.3.
